integrity: Finite arithmetic checks are separated from the analytic proof. The result uses prior two-factor formulas, classical sl2 representation theory, and a lattice local central limit theorem; their provenance is explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Complex isolated hypersurface germs; sums of a fixed germ in independent variable groups; no positive-characteristic, coupled-variable or Hodge-filtration analogue claimed. Historical priority is not independently established.
title: A universal \(k^{-1/2}\) law for Tjurina numbers of repeated Thom–Sebastiani sums
